description: This file is a shell script library for setting up, configuring, and managing an Apache HTTP server for testing purposes, especially in the context of Git's test suite. It includes functions for detecting the web server, configuring SSL, WebDAV, SVN, and HTTP/2 support, starting and stopping the server, and performing test assertions related to HTTP push operations.

methods.name: install_script
methods.description: Copies a script from the test directory to the HTTP server root, preparing it for execution.

methods.name: prepare_httpd
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP server environment, including copying configuration and test files, setting SSL if enabled, and preparing the server for testing.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the configured HTTP server with the prepared settings and configuration.

methods.name: enable_http2
methods.description: Enables HTTP/2 support in the server configuration.

methods.name: enable_cgipassauth
methods.description: Enables the CGI PassAuth module if the server version supports it.
